notes.title: 2022.11.30 Repair English patch
notes.notes:
Now after using the English patch, {Composition Table} can be displayed normally.

(Players who have used English patches, please overwrite them in the game directory again!)

notes.title: Add English language patch
notes.notes:
I tried my best to translate the main plot, props, status and notes of the game.
But because of the language difference between Chinese and English, I can't translate pornographic content into English accurately. 
I'm sorry, I've done my best.

notes.title: Added shrems combat behavior and bug fixes
notes.notes:
1. Added "H" in the battle of shrems

2. Change the image preprocessing method and fix the error【uncaught typeError:Cannot read property ＇width＇of the null】

(in fact, the picture looped too fast and made an error)

notes.title: Emergency Patch
notes.notes: Memory room now adds [defeat - shrem mother] and [Special defeat - shrem mother]

notes.title: Minor update on July 23
notes.notes:
1. Optimized the novice guidance of the preface
2. Add a new item "wild Survival Guide"
Now players can check the descriptions of various abnormal states (hunger, thirst, fatigue) in the items at any time
The task guidance system is currently being tested and is believed to be ready for use soon.

notes.title: Small update (fixed the bug that the sword is equipped but can't cut trees)
notes.notes: Now players can cut trees normally no matter they are equipped with +1 or +9 magic swords.

notes.title: Some bug fixes
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that CG cannot be viewed in CG room

2. Fix the bug that the body on the second floor of the first safe house cannot disappear

3. Try to fix other bugs
